studies.label: The folded host
studies.description: Rose folds gather around an open body. A face, a fan and a borrowed loop remain legible; the visitor is invited into the space they make.

studies.label: An excess of limbs
studies.description: Deep violet, turquoise and copper. Side fans exaggerate the silhouette; repetition becomes a chosen costume rather than a repair towards a normal body.

studies.label: The obsolete becomes precious
studies.description: Ivory facets and ink-coloured seams keep their angular construction. The older digital body is retained as material for ornament and shelter.
